properties.name: Mediterranean Sea (IHO)
properties.source: Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions, IHO Sea Areas v3 (IHO S-23, 1953)
properties.note: The union of the nine IHO sea areas that make up the Mediterranean. Excludes the Strait of Gibraltar, the Sea of Marmara and the Black Sea. Interior rings dropped (land inside the region is excluded by sst_daily holding ocean cells only). Longitudes are continuous across the region, on the 0-360 frame where the region allows and as negative degrees east where it crosses the prime meridian.
